explication: Devtron is a Kubernetes management and delivery platform. Users access a dashboard/API to manage clusters and Helm, ArgoCD, and Flux applications; platform workflows also configure and trigger CI/CD pipelines, then track deployment status. The graph includes those documented product areas and sampled internal services, repositories, and authorization components. Several dashboard capabilities are documented but their implementation was not sampled, so those subsystem links rely on the README rather than inferred source calls.
